featured.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced that Aleksander has accepted OpenAI's request to take on its safety and security work. He stressed that the safety and security challenges ahead "as we confront superintelligence are immense," and that Aleksander has an excellent set of skills for the job — a notable leadership move on OpenAI's safety governance.
featured.insightZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 宣布 Aleksander 接受邀请，负责 OpenAI 的安全与安保工作。他特别强调：在迈向超级智能的过程中，安全与安保方面的挑战"极其巨大"，而 Aleksander 的能力组合非常适合这项工作。这是 OpenAI 在安全治理层面的一次关键人事安排，值得关注后续组织调整。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux shared two key updates. First, the API now supports 12-hour caching, and for logged-in users across Codex and Work the cache is kept forever — resuming an old conversation hours later is guaranteed to hit the cache with no penalty. Second, he acknowledged that roughly 40,000 accounts had usage limits applied that didn't match their selected plan, causing faster-than-expected drain over the weekend; the issue is fixed, affected users will be contacted individually and credited, w…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 发了两条重要更新。第一，API 现支持 12 小时缓存；Codex 和 Work 的登录用户缓存永久保留，回到旧对话或隔几小时再续接也保证命中缓存、没有任何惩罚。第二，他承认周末部分用户额度消耗异常：约 4 万个账户实际执行的用量限额与所选套餐不一致，OpenAI 已修复，将逐一联系受影响用户并补发额度，并公开致歉。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues a clear new form factor for AI is emerging: autonomous systems dedicated to specific tasks or domains — a big leap past the LLM-wrapper days. He cites three drivers: (1) better tool and computer use lets agents execute workflows the way a person would, and build software where none exists; (2) model capability is improving across verticals like legal, bio research, code security and supply chain; (3) harnesses and infra — sandboxes, file systems, data pipelines — now support long-running…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，AI 已出现一种清晰的新形态：面向特定任务或领域的自主系统，远超"LLM 套壳"时代。他给出三个驱动力：一是模型的工具调用与计算机操作能力提升，Agent 可以像人一样执行工作流，没有现成软件时甚至自己构建；二是模型在法律、生物研究、代码安全、供应链等垂直领域的判断力持续增强；三是沙箱、文件系统、数据管道等 harness 与基础设施成熟，支撑长时运行、处理复杂任务和海量数据。他强调配合合适的 UX、实施与变革管理（人仍在环中），这类系统已在 IT 自动化、网络安全运营、药物发现、制造、AI 研究等领域出现，未来经济中几乎每个角色都可能对应一个或多个这样的系统。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch announced that, as with the AI SDK, Vercel is bringing an open-source, runtime-agnostic solution for harness durability — extending the infra behind eve and Workflows to all harnesses like Pi and OpenCode, running locally, on Vercel, or DIY. Claude Code and Codex can also be made durable and observable this way, but since they aren't designed for embedding, they're less efficient, less portable and need an extra sandbox. Separately, he envisions AI computing the exact delta between what…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 宣布，像当年做 AI SDK 一样，Vercel 将推出真正开源、与运行时无关的 Agent harness 持久化（durability）方案：把支撑 eve 和 Workflows 的持久化基础设施扩展到 Pi、OpenCode 等所有 harness，可在本地、Vercel 或自建环境运行。他提到 Claude Code 和 Codex 也能用这种方式变得可持久、可观测，但它们目前并非为嵌入设计，因此效率更低、可移植性更差，还需要额外沙箱。另一条他畅想：AI 能精准计算出"你懂与不懂之间的差量"，帮人渐进式学会任何东西——免费的终极教育。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger shared his multi-agent workflow: Astra plans, Sol 6.1 codes, and prompting Astra to run codex cli in worktrees works "FAR better" than relying on subagents. A second agent oversees the work to keep Astra on track — like /goal, but instead of the same agent re-reading a text file, a separate agent challenges it. He wrote an OpenClaw plugin for this "smart goal" feature. He'll also be at Cloudflare Connect talking agents with @dok2001.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger 分享了他的多 Agent 工作流：由 Astra 做规划、Sol 6.1 写代码；他发现让 Astra 在 git worktree 中调用 codex cli，效果"远好于"依赖子 Agent。另有第二个 Agent 负责监督、挑战 Astra 保持方向——类似 /goal，但不是同一个 Agent 自查文本文件，而是由另一个 Agent 质询。他为此写了一个 OpenClaw 插件实现"smart goal"功能。他还将在 Cloudflare Connect 上与 @dok2001 对谈 Agent。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · SPC 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Former Dropbox CTO and SPC GP Aditya Agarwal draws a parallel: Inference-time scaling → Subagents → Agent Swarms looks a lot like CPU Threads → Multi-core CPUs → Multi-node Distributed Systems. History rhymes — implying decades of distributed-systems lessons on coordination, scheduling and fault tolerance may replay in agent architectures.
items.insightZh: 前 Dropbox CTO、SPC 合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 做了一个类比："推理时扩展 → 子 Agent → Agent 集群"的演进路径，与"CPU 线程 → 多核 CPU → 多节点分布式系统"惊人相似。历史总是押韵——这意味着分布式系统几十年积累的协调、调度、容错经验，很可能会在 Agent 架构中重演。

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App 副总裁
items.summaryEn: Google Labs and Gemini App VP Josh Woodward said the Gemini App Trusted Tester community just crossed a big milestone — lots of people want early access on Web, Android and iOS; everyone who previously signed up is fully in, and new sign-ups are open. He also quoted Sundar: "We are so committed to being at the frontier. It's in our DNA," inviting people to come build with them.
items.insightZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini App 副总裁 Josh Woodward 表示，Gemini App 的 Trusted Tester 社区刚跨过一个重要里程碑——大量用户想在 Web、Android 和 iOS 上抢先试用新功能；此前报名过的已全部通过，新用户可继续报名。他还引用 Sundar Pichai 的话："我们致力于站在前沿，这是我们的 DNA"，并招募人才加入。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI Engineer 创始人
items.summaryEn: Latent Space's Swyx complained that Opus is great for writing — unless your prompt happens to contain random "no-no words." Echoing @CompleteSkeptic's "give me prod, not god," he said he can't build an AI media org with that in the critical path. He also tried getting Codex to make animated explainer videos and concluded "ngmi."
items.insightZh: Latent Space 主理人 Swyx 吐槽：Opus 写作能力很强，但前提是 prompt 里没有碰到某些"敏感词"——他认同 @CompleteSkeptic 的说法"give me prod, not god"，表示无法把这种不确定性放在 AI 媒体业务的关键路径上。他还尝试让 Codex 生成动画讲解视频，结论是"ngmi（搞不定）"。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark 合伙人、MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: FirstMark's Matt Turck highlighted a busy day for portfolio companies: FirstMark led Daytona's Series B after leading its Series A earlier this year; Baba announced its Series A; Gradium AI launched a suite of tiny open-source, on-device SOTA text-to-speech models; and Synthesia and Rillet took over the NYC subway with ads.
items.insightZh: FirstMark 合伙人 Matt Turck 晒出被投企业的密集好消息：继领投 A 轮后再次领投 Daytona 的 B 轮；Baba 宣布 A 轮；Gradium AI 发布开源、端侧运行的 SOTA 小型语音合成模型套件；Synthesia 与 Rillet 的广告"占领"纽约地铁。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President Garry Tan said GStack is now Capy-aware and works well with Capy's software-factory feature, Captains. He also recommended a tool for reaching the right people, calling it the "greatest unlock" for founders.
items.insightZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 表示，他开发的 GStack 现已支持 Capy，并能与 Capy 的"软件工厂"功能 Captains 良好配合。他另外推荐了一个帮助创业者联系到关键人物的工具，称其为"最大的解锁"。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Builder Zara Zhang argues that for early-stage product builders, the biggest advantage of having your own audience isn't distribution — it's being able to test ideas and angles to see what resonates, and to find your first 100 early adopters. Signals > distribution.
items.insightZh: Builder Zara Zhang 认为，对早期产品构建者来说，拥有自己受众的最大价值不是分发，而是两点：可以测试不同想法与切入角度、看什么能引起共鸣；以及找到最初 100 个早期用户。一句话：信号 > 分发。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper reviewed Meghan O'Gieblyn's "Will and Attention," which recounts her relapse into alcoholism and the limits of pragmatic truth: adopting beliefs because they "work" opens a gap between desires and behavior — and invites the question of whether they really work. He notes we all do such rationalizing, and that her turn back toward inviolable truth still seems to rest on pragmatic grounds. He also joked about an agent whose approval policy was "never," so it needed approval but couldn't ask for…
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 推荐了 Meghan O'Gieblyn 的新书《Will and Attention》。书中作者讲述自己酗酒复发，探讨"实用主义真理"的困境：把信念当作"有用才采纳"的工具，会在真实欲望与行为之间留下缝隙，也打开了"它可能并不有用"的口子。Shipper 认为这种自我合理化的心理体操人人都在做，并指出作者转向"不可侵犯的真理"本身似乎仍建立在实用主义之上。另外他吐槽某 Agent 的审批策略设为 never，导致它需要审批却无法申请审批。

items.title: Google Labs · Google AI 实验产品
items.summaryEn: Google Labs launched a three-part "Dreambeans Roulette" series in which PM Sahana R., VP of Product Brian R. and his dog Nala demo Dreambeans: open it, pick a story, then go out and do it. Dreambeans is available in the US for users 18+, with more regions coming soon.
items.insightZh: Google Labs 推出"Dreambeans Roulette"三集系列内容：由产品经理 Sahana R.、产品副总裁 Brian R. 带着他的狗 Nala 演示新产品 Dreambeans——打开应用、选择一个故事、然后照着去做。Dreambeans 目前面向美国 18 岁以上用户开放，更多地区即将上线。
